decided: The address-reviews skill's new short description says it walks every outstanding review pass a change's gates report, as well as review comments left in files, so a reader choosing the skill still learns that it finds a change's open reviews by itself.
alternatives: use the drafted description word for word, which no longer says that the skill finds a change's open reviews by itself
why: The design left the three new descriptions to be finalized during implementation; the draft dropped the one fact an existing check holds the description to, and adding one clause keeps it at about 400 characters, well under the 1,024 limit.
